name: ralphex
headline: ralphex - Autonomous AI Plan Execution
short_description: ralphex automates plan execution using AI agents. Operations teams benefit from autonomous task completion, reducing manual oversight. It connects to workflows requiring iterative task management and integrates with Claude agents for decision-making.
author: umputun

sections.overview:
Ralphex is an automation platform that executes plans using AI agents, enabling operations teams to delegate iterative task management without constant manual oversight. It integrates with Claude agents to support intelligent decision-making throughout workflow execution. The system accepts plans in multiple formats and converts them into structured execution workflows. By automating task completion and tracking, ralphex reduces operational friction and enables teams to focus on higher-level priorities. It's designed for scenarios requiring sequential task execution with agent-driven intelligence.
Converting change management plans from various formats into executable workflows
Automating multi-step operational procedures with autonomous agent decision-making
Managing checklist-based tasks from GitHub/GitLab issues with AI oversight
Reducing manual monitoring in iterative deployment and infrastructure workflows
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/umputun/ralphex`
sections.usage:
```
Use ralphex to automate the execution of [PLAN_NAME] for [TEAM_OR_DEPARTMENT]. The plan involves [BRIEF_DESCRIPTION_OF_TASKS]. Monitor progress in [TOOL_OR_PLATFORM] and escalate issues to [CONTACT_PERSON] if any step fails. Ensure all dependencies are resolved before proceeding to the next task.
```
Copy

```
The ralphex agent initiated the 'Q3 Marketing Campaign Rollout' plan for the Growth Team, which included tasks like drafting email templates, scheduling social media posts, and updating the CRM with campaign data. The agent first validated dependencies by checking if the campaign brief and brand guidelines were uploaded to Notion. It then delegated the email template task to the Content Team’s Claude agent, which generated three versions within 20 minutes. The social media scheduling task was auto-assigned to the Design Team’s agent, which used Canva to create visuals and scheduled them via Hootsuite for optimal engagement times. The CRM update task was handled by the Sales Team’s agent, which cross-referenced the campaign data with existing customer segments and flagged 12 high-priority leads for the sales team to follow up on. By the end of the day, ralphex reported 85% task completion, with the remaining tasks (finalizing the landing page and setting up tracking pixels) delayed due to a dependency on the Dev Team’s approval. The agent automatically notified the Growth Team lead, Maria Lopez, via Slack and suggested a 24-hour buffer to resolve the dependency before resuming execution.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
